description: Empty-domain neutral ABL homogeneity check on the applied domain (Project.md section 5, step V0).

Uref_mps.note: U_H at roof height; sweep speed from Project.md section 4

z0_m.note: Aerodynamic roughness length, suburban/industrial, Project.md section 4

kappa.note: von Karman; 0.40 is the value for which sigmaEps=1.11 makes the RH profiles an exact k-eps solution (HW 2007 p.358)

nu_m2ps.note: Air at ~20 C, kinematic viscosity, standard tables

sigmaEps_HW.note: Hargreaves & Wright 2007 modification for standard k-epsilon only

domain.note: x and z from Project.md section 4; y is a thin 3-cell slab (dx-sized cells) with symmetry sides because V0 has no building; one cell would fail checkMesh's determinant test

numerics.note: dx = far-field size of Project.md section 7; endTime and residualControl chosen from the smoke test, where all residuals were flat by iteration ~1000

monitor.note: Profiles along z at each station; probe of U at the building position at roof height, written every iteration

acceptance.quantity: max relative change of U and of k between inlet patch and x=0 (building position), 0 < z < 3H
acceptance.source: Project.md section 5, V0 row; fixed before the runs

kEpsilonHW.note: Standard k-eps with HW fix; reference, known to maintain profiles

std.note: As in the official tutorial; nut is z0-aware, dissipation is not

A.note: uniform 4 m, y/z0 = 6.7, applied far-field size

B.note: graded, first cell 1 m, y/z0 = 1.7, building refinement reaching the ground

C.note: graded, first cell 0.5 m, y/z0 = 0.8, the 0.5 m building refinement reaching the ground (added 2026-10-08 after meshes A and B)
